Use the **HTTP PUT** method with the resource’s logical ID:

```http
PUT [base]/Patient/[id]
```

Example:

```http
PUT https://example.org/fhir/Patient/123
```

The request body contains the complete updated `Patient` resource, whose `id` should match the URL ID. Conditional updates may instead use `PUT [base]/Patient?[search-parameters]`.
